resources.string: A map of how you feel
Mark the places where something moved you — they stay on your map.
An emotion, a note, photos and videos — everything you want to remember about it.
The calendar and summaries show how your mood has changed.
The map opens where you are, and a new memory lands right on that spot. Your location never leaves the phone.
Drag the map to the spot
We sat on the bench until it got dark. I want to come back.
